data.turoyo: Ḥəšwina amṭelan abro me larwal w mrabelan. W ṭro dis d əzzeyo. Ayko d kəzze, ṭr=əzze, gmətbarʕina mene.
data.translation: Laß uns denken, wir hätten einen Sohn von draußen geholt und großgezogen; und er mag wieder gehen! Wohin er geht, da mag er hingehen; wir werden uns von ihm lossagen.

rationale: Thin Infectum cell; a different complete renunciation sentence with third-person m- complement, already cited as a parallel but not yet quoted. No claim of a new citation.

summary: Both forms are first-plural g-Infectum of the lexically listed tbrʕ I. The initial mt- belongs to this borrowed verb's stem representation and does not by itself license a Detransitive analysis.
The disowned person is m-marked, with second-person menux and third-person mene. The change in referent does not create a sense.
87/23 is the exact inherited quote. 87/35 is already a parallel reference, but its different full renunciation sentence is not printed there; the added context is not claimed as a new attestation.

The supplied headword's donation-oriented Arabic etymology and its disowning gloss do not transparently match. The corpus confirms disowning, not donation; historical/root identification remains open.
